Independent finite exact-rank enumeration and integer-site geometry witnesses passed using the included executable; no finite experiment serves as the proof.

value.rationale: The motivating arbitrary-site Voronoi visibility paper proposes exact expected degrees for iid null testing but reports highly fluctuating sampled degrees. A geometry-conditioned variance is the natural precision/standardization term and is not obtainable from the mean alone. Explicit opposite-sign covariances in genuine irregular four-site geometries show why naive independence errors can point in either direction; the result applies without arbitrary geometric slices.
